notes.title: Demo Update 1
notes.content:
Additions:
Time and score icons instead of raw text

Range indicator and crosshair while holding a cast button
Bug Fixes:
Selling at a shop sells the item and removes the effect

Real-time trinkets (e.g. Sage Pendulum) no longer continuously reset certain variables, so casting will slow the player as intended

Eversear will appear where you cast it
Changes:
Spells are cast on mouse button release due to range indicator addition

Eversear: +range

Flame Claw: -range
Bugs I'm Aware of but Don't Know How To Fix Right Now:
Shops stop appearing in some cases

Crash during death in some cases

Element selection prompt after death in some cases

notes.title: First Fusion Mage Update
notes.content:
What is Fusion Mage?A spell-casting roguelite
Fusion Mage is a work in progress. This is a solo project, and I want to continue developing Fusion Mage's core to produce two separate game modes, Survival and Adventure.



Both game modes share core elements that were developed first:

Element-swapping spell system

Character attributes

Items that change game plans

Meaningful buffs and debuffs


Survival
Infinite spawning monsters

Shops for upgrades

Progressive difficulty


Adventure*
*WIP Tools so far:

'Sector' generation with connected nodes for level selection

Templated procedural terrain for temples/dungeons

Noisey procedural generation for caves/outdoor

Barriers destructible by some elements



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586295/c01aa549d86a2230f067f217706e57eb157d6151.png"]

Survival is playable on Steam now via the demo, but is still in development. It serves as a test ground for item combos and the runs are simple.



Adventure is the game mode in development since the start: a focus on spells, trinkets, and randomness in a world with more choices. You'll select levels on a map to fight tougher enemies, collect gems, buy items, and find each element.



I'm happy to continue developing both modes, and I look forward to a full release of Fusion Mage in the future...
